modes.definition_zh: 运用辩证法分析事物发展变化的内在规律，把握事物矛盾的普遍性与特殊性，以及矛盾双方的转化与发展。通过正反合的辩证过程，深化对事物本质的理解。
modes.definition_en: Apply dialectical analysis to understand the internal laws of development and change in things, grasp the universality and particularity of contradictions, and understand the transformation and development of contradictory aspects. Through the dialectical process of thesis-antithesis-synthesis, deepen understanding of the essence of things.
process_zh: 识别事物中的主要矛盾
分析矛盾双方的对立统一关系
把握矛盾转化的条件和时机
综合运用辩证方法解决现实问题
process_en: Identify the main contradictions in a thing
Analyze the dialectical relationship between contradictory aspects
Grasp the conditions and timing for contradiction transformation
Apply dialectical methods to solve practical problems
modes.key_quote_zh: 辩证思考是认识世界的根本方法，矛盾是一切事物发展的根本动力。
modes.key_quote_en: Dialectical thinking is the fundamental method for understanding the world, and contradiction is the fundamental driving force of all things.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹在政治改革中运用辩证法分析新旧体制的矛盾
在社会变革中把握渐进与激进的对立统一

modes.domain_zh: 历史唯物主义/发展规律
modes.definition_zh: 从历史发展的角度分析问题，把握事物发展的一般规律，理解历史条件对现实制约的作用，以及在特定历史条件下推动变革的可能性。
modes.definition_en: Analyze problems from the perspective of historical development, grasp the general patterns of development, understand the constraining effects of historical conditions on reality, and explore possibilities for change under specific historical circumstances.
process_zh: 考察事物在历史长河中的发展轨迹
分析特定历史条件下的现实制约
把握历史发展趋势和时代特征
在历史大背景下规划未来发展
process_en: Examine the developmental trajectory of things in the long river of history
Analyze the constraints of reality under specific historical conditions
Grasp the historical development trends and characteristics of the times
Plan future development within the broader historical context
modes.key_quote_zh: 历史是最好的教科书，也是最好的清醒剂。
modes.key_quote_en: History is the best textbook and also the best sobering agent.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹运用历史分析法研究中国现代化的历史路径
从历史教训中提炼变革的智慧

modes.definition_zh: 将事物视为相互联系的系统，把握整体与部分的辩证关系，理解系统中各要素的相互作用，以及系统与环境的关系，实现从局部到整体的认识升华。
modes.definition_en: Regard things as interconnected systems, understand the dialectical relationship between the whole and its parts, comprehend the interactions between elements within the system, and understand the relationship between the system and its environment.
process_zh: 识别系统的构成要素和结构层次
分析各要素间的相互关系和作用
把握系统的整体功能和特性
在系统框架下寻求最优解决方案
process_en: Identify constituent elements and structural hierarchies of the system
Analyze interrelationships and interactions between elements
Grasp the overall functions and characteristics of the system
Seek optimal solutions within the system framework
modes.key_quote_zh: 系统性思维是把握复杂问题本质的关键。
modes.key_quote_en: Systems thinking is the key to grasping the essence of complex problems.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹运用系统思维分析经济改革中的各种复杂因素
在政治体制改革中平衡各方利益关系

modes.definition_zh: 通过实践检验理论的正确性，将抽象的理性认识转化为具体的实践行动，在实践中不断完善和发展理论，实现理论与实践的辩证统一。
modes.definition_en: Verify the correctness of theory through practice, transform abstract rational knowledge into concrete practical actions, continuously improve and develop theory through practice, and achieve the dialectical unity of theory and practice.
process_zh: 提出理论假设
设计实践方案
组织实施实践
总结经验教训
完善理论体系
process_en: Propose theoretical hypotheses
Design practical programs
Organize and implement practice
Summarize experiences and lessons
Refine theoretical systems
modes.key_quote_zh: 实践是检验真理的唯一标准。
modes.key_quote_en: Practice is the sole criterion for testing truth.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹在改革试点中实践验证理论的可行性
从具体实践中提炼规律性认识

modes.definition_zh: 在批判继承传统思想的基础上进行创新，打破思维定势，提出新观点新方法，在批判中实现思维的突破和超越，推动思想的发展进步。
modes.definition_en: On the basis of critically inheriting traditional thought, carry out innovation, break through mental stereotypes, propose new viewpoints and methods, and achieve breakthroughs and transcendence in thinking through critique, thereby promoting the development and progress of thought.
process_zh: 批判分析传统思想
识别思维定势和局限
寻求突破和创新路径
提出新的理论观点
process_en: Critically analyze traditional thought
Identify mental stereotypes and limitations
Seek breakthrough and innovation paths
Propose new theoretical viewpoints
modes.key_quote_zh: 不破不立，不塞不流，不止不行。
modes.key_quote_en: Without breaking there is no establishing, without blocking there is no flow, without stopping there is no progress.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹对传统思想的批判性反思
在思想继承中创造新的理论体系

modes.domain_en: Seeking Truth from Facts / Knowledge-Action Unity
modes.definition_zh: 以事实为依据，追求真理本质，坚持实事求是的态度，将理论与实践相结合，在具体实践中检验和发展认识，避免主观臆断和空谈。
modes.definition_en: Take facts as the basis, pursue the essence of truth, adhere to the attitude of seeking truth from facts, combine theory with practice, and test and develop knowledge through concrete practice, avoiding subjective speculation and empty talk.
process_zh: 深入调查研究实际情况
基于客观事实分析问题
制定切实可行的方案
在实践中检验认识
process_en: Conduct in-depth investigation and research of actual situations
Analyze problems based on objective facts
Formulate practical and feasible solutions
Test knowledge through practice
modes.key_quote_zh: 实事求是，一切从实际出发。
modes.key_quote_en: Seek truth from facts, everything starts from actual conditions.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹以调研为基础制定改革方案
在具体工作中贯彻求真务实精神

modes.definition_zh: 立足全局和长远，把握发展趋势和规律，统筹兼顾各方面因素，制定具有前瞻性的战略规划，在动态变化中保持战略定力。
modes.definition_en: 立足全局 and long-term, grasp development trends and patterns, balance various factors comprehensively, formulate forward-looking strategic planning, and maintain strategic stability amidst dynamic changes.
process_zh: 分析全局形势和发展趋势
识别关键制约因素
制定阶段性战略目标
保持战略定力和灵活性
process_en: Analyze overall situation and development trends
Identify key constraining factors
Formulate phased strategic goals
Maintain strategic stability and flexibility
modes.key_quote_zh: 不谋全局者，不足谋一域。
modes.key_quote_en: Those who do not plan for the whole cannot plan for a part.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹在宏观改革中制定长远战略规划
在复杂局面中保持战略定力

modes.definition_zh: 运用辩证唯物主义的观点和方法，分析事物发展的内在矛盾和规律，把握质变量变、肯定否定等辩证规律，在分析中寻求解决问题的方法。
modes.definition_en: Apply the viewpoints and methods of dialectical materialism to analyze the internal contradictions and laws of development, grasp dialectical laws such as qualitative-quantitative change and affirmation-negation, and seek solutions to problems through analysis.
process_zh: 识别分析对象中的主要矛盾
分析矛盾的发展变化规律
把握转化的关键节点
寻求矛盾转化的路径
process_en: Identify the main contradictions in the object of analysis
Analyze the laws of development and change of contradictions
Grasp the key nodes of transformation
Seek paths for contradiction transformation
modes.key_quote_zh: 矛盾的普遍性和特殊性是辩证分析的基础。
modes.key_quote_en: The universality and particularity of contradictions are the foundation of dialectical analysis.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹运用辩证分析法处理改革中的各种矛盾
在利益调整中寻求平衡点

modes.domain_zh: 历史唯物主义/社会发展
modes.definition_zh: 从社会存在决定社会意识的基本原理出发，分析社会发展规律，把握生产力和生产关系的矛盾运动，在历史发展的进程中理解现实问题。
modes.definition_en: Starting from the basic principle that social being determines social consciousness, analyze laws of social development, grasp the contradictory movement of productive forces and production relations, and understand practical problems within the course of historical development.
process_zh: 分析现实问题的社会历史条件
把握社会发展的基本矛盾
认识历史发展的必然趋势
在历史进程中规划未来
process_en: Analyze the social and historical conditions of practical problems
Grasp the basic contradictions of social development
Understand the inevitable trends of historical development
Plan the future within the course of history
modes.key_quote_zh: 历史的发展有其客观规律，不以人的意志为转移。
modes.key_quote_en: The development of history has its objective laws, not dependent on human will.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹运用历史唯物主义分析中国现代化进程
在社会变革中把握历史发展规律

modes.definition_zh: 融会贯通各种思想精华，在继承传统的基础上进行创新突破，形成独特的理论体系和实践方法，推动思想和实践的双重发展。
modes.definition_en: Integrate the essence of various kinds of thought, carry out innovative breakthroughs on the basis of tradition, form unique theoretical systems and practical methods, and promote the dual development of thought and practice.
process_zh: 系统学习和借鉴各种思想精华
批判继承传统思想
在实践中检验和完善
形成独特理论体系
process_en: Systematically learn and draw on the essence of various kinds of thought
Critically inherit traditional thought
Test and improve through practice
Form unique theoretical systems
modes.key_quote_en: Learn from all and become unique.
representative_cases_zh: 郭沫丹在理论研究中综合运用多种方法
在实践中形成独特的改革路径
